description: Component mole and total mass balance closure for all 33 configurations x 3 pressure cases
method: sum of product and tail flows minus feed, per species, relative

description: Sieverts flux hand calculation at 673.15 K, p_H2,ret 14 bar, permeate 1 bar, Pe0 4.57e-8, Ea 9.23 kJ/mol, 5.2 um
method: flux = Pe0 exp(-Ea/RT)/d * (p_ret^0.5 - p_perm^0.5), computed separately with R = 8.314462618

description: Recovery at very large area approaches the partial-pressure pinch limit y_H2 P_feed = P_perm
method: integrate with 1e6 m2 and compare with closed-form pinch

description: PSA published point reproduced when applied to the Aspen cracked gas: recovery 0.756 and purity (H2/(H2+N2), NH3 at 0.1 ppm) 0.9911
method: psa_split with Cho recovery and purity; this reproduces the input by construction, so it is a bookkeeping check, not validation of PSA physics

description: H2/N2 selectivity needed for N2 <= 300 ppm in the permeate at R = 0.90, 1 bar permeate, 400 degC, 20 bar baseline
method: bisection on ideal selectivity; compared with measured Pd-Ag purity 99.995 % (50 ppm total impurities) at 450 degC, 4.61 um (a membrane reactor, different feed), and (Phase 2) with the sourced ideal H2/N2 of cechetto2021fpt Sec. 3.1 (stated above 400,000; about 40,500 from the printed double-sealed N2 permeance): see P2-SEL-1

description: Comparison with Cechetto 4 bar / 400 degC membrane reactor (X 99.3 %, R_H2 93.5 %)
method: not performed: that is a reactor result (reaction plus separation, vacuum permeate, lab module) and the library gives neither the module area nor Sieverts parameters of that membrane; a separator model cannot be compared with it

description: ISO 14687:2019 grade D limits transcribed (H2 index 99.97 %, total 300, H2O 5, N2 300, NH3 0.1 umol/mol)
method: values compared with the cited limits quoted in cechetto2023membrane p. 5 (NH3 0.1 ppm, N2 300 ppm)

description: Aspen baseline H2PROD stream (N2 0.0489 kmol/h, NH3 0) against grade D N2 limit: N2 ppm (Aspen stream)
method: N2 / (H2 + N2) from results/simulations/baseline.json H2PROD, compared with 300 umol/mol

description: SGD LCOH equals USD LCOH x 1.288444 for every Phase 2 configuration
method: max absolute difference

description: Phase 2 code path reproduces the stored MEM_1bar_polish Grade D LCOH when given the Phase 1 inputs (6000 EUR/m2, 3 yr, infinite selectivity)
method: recompute through purification_phase2 helpers

description: Phase 2 code path reproduces the stored PSA_D_MB Grade D LCOH
method: recompute

description: Membrane cost at parity (Grade D, PSA central recovery) gives LCOH equal to the PSA LCOH
method: re-evaluate at the solved cost

description: At fixed ideal selectivity, permeate N2 rises with recovery (more area, lower H2 driving force)
method: monotonicity over the trade-off grid

description: Required ideal H2/N2 for Grade D N2 300 ppm against the sourced Cechetto 2021 values
method: required value from required_selectivity at R 0.90, 1 bar, 400 degC; sourced: 40,500 (printed permeances), 400,000 (stated), 500,000 (dead end); ideal, new membrane, 450 degC

description: Cechetto 2021 dead-end ratio of printed permeances reproduces the stated selectivity above 500,000
Cechetto 2021 double-sealed ratio of printed permeances against the stated selectivity above 400,000
method: 1.5e-6 / 3.7e-11 (printed exponent -11)

description: PSA recovery at Grade D against Yanez 2020 (55.5 % at 99.97 %)
method: not a validation: AmCraX has no adsorption-cycle model; the Yanez point is a different feed (purge gas). Reported as a pessimistic input case only

description: AmCraX PSA recovery assumption 0.85 at 99.96 % against the published front for a cracked-ammonia composition (Abdoos 2025 Table 8: 0.8192 at 99.95 %, 0.7744 at 99.99 %)
method: comparison of an input with a simulated literature front; no AmCraX adsorption-cycle model; dry NH3-free feed at 11.3-11.6 bar against 19.5 bar; surrogate scatter 1-3 points
note: the assumption lies above the front at matching purity; the baseline sensitivity is in reference_scenario/baseline.json psa_recovery_sensitivity

description: AmCraX mass-balance central recoveries (0.7516 at 99.91 %, 0.7513 at 99.975 %) against the Abdoos 2025 front
method: comparison with the Table 8 point of the next higher purity (front assumed monotonic)
note: both mass-balance values lie below the front: the earlier label 'optimistic' is withdrawn

description: Grade D LCOH at the three Abdoos recoveries rises as recovery falls (computed with the model at each recovery, not interpolated)
method: monotonicity of the computed LCOH over 0.8392 > 0.8192 > 0.7744

description: Purity-only Grade D increment at equal (30 bar) delivery on the Abdoos 2025 relation against the model resolution (Python against Aspen LCOH offset)
method: industrial at 0.8192, Grade D at 0.7744, both delivered at 30 bar; relation simulated for a dry NH3-free feed at 11.3-11.6 bar, applied at 19.5 bar
note: above the resolution (13.3 times) at the printed recoveries, but -0.0273 with 3 points of adverse surrogate scatter; the Yanez relation (different feed) gives 0.1657 and the assumed mass-balance relation 0.0020 (below the resolution); the coded H4-b rule is unchanged

description: Reference baseline LCOH (PSA 0.85 at 99.96 %) beside the same economics code path at the Abdoos 2025 recoveries 0.8192 (99.95 %) and 0.7744 (99.99 %)
method: singapore.evaluate psa_recovery override (linear re-scaling of the stored Aspen result); reference value frozen
note: sensitivity beside the frozen reference; the reference value does not change
